overview.description: The spectrophotometer measures optical density (OD600) - how much light your culture blocks as it grows. It's how you choose the right moment to induce protein expression. It's relatively easy to DIY.

steps.intro: The spectrophotometer measures optical density (OD600) - how much light your culture blocks as it grows. It's how you choose the right moment to induce protein expression. It's relatively easy to DIY.

instructions.title: Blank the instrument
instructions.description: Zero the reading with a cuvette of sterile media.

instructions.title: Measure OD600
instructions.description: Read your culture at 600 nm; dilute if the reading exceeds the linear range.

instructions.title: Map to growth
instructions.description: Track OD600 over time to identify exponential phase for induction.

submission.description: Record a short OD600 time-course of a growing culture and identify the exponential phase.
